git diff --name-only without -z and --no-renames quotes non-ASCII names; such a path fails the exists filter and is dropped silently, so a command may be skipped as no changed files. Rename output depends on diff.renames.

The base of the changed files is under-defined: state.json may have no base; the checked commit may not be HEAD (closed ticket); diff base HEAD after a merge of the base branch includes other tickets' files.

Counted finding ignores triage verdicts (triage::state_of regrades severity and marks false); a false or regraded finding is counted and a false deferred finding gets a record. The order and separator of the stage/rule pairs and a rule with , or : are open.

The ledger write failure paths have no criterion: an append after the save that fails loses the records with no recovery; a malformed findings line, a malformed ledger line, a claim over 64 KiB and the order against record_decision are not stated or tested.
The check record trims only steps to fit MAX_RECORD; project and history entries are unbounded, so many commands or a long reason leave the record unwritten. The field shapes are not stated.

AC-13 leaves open: the round N pack has no findings (write_pack reads round 1 only); next_round still stops after round 2; the round 0 message says 1 or 2; existing tests of review.rs use --round 3 as a bad round and no Plan step edits them.

AC-9: a history commit that edits a step's test gives a test that never failed at RED, because RED ran the old text; a careless agent can weaken an assertion in the GREEN with history: fix. Added and deleted tests in a history commit are not stated.
Node pin: different versions undefined (text or numbers), which error wins, no deadline for node --version, the levels and history mode where the pin applies.
History line: the subject case has no expected result; two lines in one commit; commits of the base branch inside the range; the place of the history lines in history mode.
Project commands: what counts as the word {files}; a path that starts with -; the suite used the whole deadline; the environment of the command.
The history reason is free text: history: x on every commit removes the tests-changed and build-input rules; a count limit or a close line per history commit is a proposal for the person.
